lines.x: Yes, I'll protect the Doctor.
I can sit down? No... I'm a bodyguard. As a bodyguard, I have to stay vigilant and keep close to my principal... Am I... perhaps being a bother, standing here?
Spot? I've met him before... No, actually, when my unit passed through the city he was stationed in, he gave me a hand. He probably doesn't remember. It's fine.
(I'm not sure what the Doctor is doing, but it looks incredible...) Eh? Uh... I-I didn't say anything. Must've been the wind, Doctor.
Doctor, you mentioned these just a second ago, so I went and fetched them for you. Umm... I hope I didn't overstep?

Doctor, I'm so sorry. I rushed in alone again on that last mission... I saw someone was wounded, and it felt like the blood surged straight to my head. I forgot your orders and charged on in. I didn't do it on purpose. P-Please don't hate me..
Umm, Doctor, were you looking for me...? No, I'm not avoiding you, and I definitely don't hate you... It's just that... Sorry, I'm not sure how to put it into words…

When I was serving in the Sargonian army, everyone hated me, except for one woman. She was kind to me, and we became best friends. But... in the end... she betrayed me. Doctor, I'm lost. How can I bring myself to trust anyone ever again?

(The Doctor is so kind, speaking so nicely to me, even though I'm such an unlikable whelp. I should be able to trust the Doctor, right?) Oh, Doctor, I'm listening. Yes, you're still my ever-dependable Doctor. The Doctor's enemies are my enemies!
(I think I'd like to sneak a peek… at the Doctor's sleeping face.)
(This one looks kind enough, but will this Doctor be as easy to get along with as Amiya says...?) Ah, excuse me, I'm sorry, I-I was spacing out. Operator, codename Heavyrain, reporting in.
Yes, I should be able to reach this level too.
(Amiya is here too. Am I getting fired...?) Eh? I'm getting promoted?
Doctor, is it okay if I don't get promoted...? No, everyone is being so kind... I'm a little scared...
By your command.
I'll do my best.
(I mustn't betray the Doctor's high hopes...)
Incoming!
I'm here.
Doctor, your orders, please?
Okay.
Right here will do.
Die.
Out of the way!
You're in the way!
Hmph!
Doctor, did I do okay?
Doctor, I can still fight.
Doctor, let me go after them.
Doctor, I'll cover you from the rear!
Rhodes Island is so big...
Ehhh?!
Doctor?! Please don't scare me...!
Arknights.

Doctor, Happy New Year. Since I came to Rhodes Island, you have cared much for me, but you've never expressed gratitude to me. So today, at the very least, I want to sincerely thank you. (Th-There, I said it! I… I didn't mess up, did I?)
Doctor, can I assist you in any way?

(The Doctor is so popular. Would someone of such stature really need a gift from a girl like me…? But I really do want to give one…) Oh, what am I holding? Well, um, it's a gift. Please, accept it! Happy birthday!

(They're all surrounding the Doctor. That is to be expected, considering the Doctor's popularity… Oh, the Doctor is waving at me. Is there something behind me? Huh, the Doctor is coming over…) Oh, should I join in the festivities…? Alright.
